r0_control_vanishing_theorem.theorem: On (S²×S²)/Z₂ with Ric=Λg, Λ>0, for any EH kernel direction ζ ∈ ker R^ε at any A₁ node and any chirality ε, the Ozuch second obstruction coefficients satisfy μ_k(ζ^ε) = 0 for k=1,2,3.

proof_step_1.argument: The degree-4 del Pezzo surface Bl₄CP² admits KE metrics with Ric = Λg (Tian 1990, Siu 1988). By LeBrun-Singer/Topiwala/Ozuch theory, these approach the product orbifold along nondegenerate comparable-scale sequences with all EH compatible (Kähler). Ozuch's necessary conditions (eq.(23), t²μ_k = O(t^{5/2})) at comparable scales give |μ_k| ≤ Ct^{1/2}. Since μ_k is t-independent (determined by orbifold geometry and ζ only), taking t→0 forces μ_k = 0.

proof_step_2.claim: μ_k for reversed EH = μ_k for compatible EH
proof_step_2.argument: The reflection c(z,w)=(z̄,w) is an isometry of the product orbifold that (i) fixes every A₁ node, (ii) preserves the local orbifold chart, (iii) exchanges Λ⁺↔Λ⁻. Since R⁺=R⁻ on the product and ∇Rm≡0, the local Ozuch source terms (Λ·eh, Q^(2)(h₂,h₂), H₂, H₄) are all c-equivariant. Therefore μ_k(ζ⁻) = μ_k(c_*ζ⁺) = μ_k(ζ⁺) = 0.

proof_step_3.argument: Since ∇Rm≡0 on the product orbifold, the local H₂ and H₄ are the same algebraic object at all four nodes. Combined with D₈ symmetry permuting nodes, μ_k is independent of the node.

r0_control_vanishing_theorem.conclusion: μ_k = 0 (k=1,2,3) at every node, for both chiralities, in every pattern. The local Ozuch second obstruction system is trivially satisfied. This does NOT require computing the Biq16 formula — it follows from the existence of the r=0 KE control.
r0_control_vanishing_theorem.strength: This is stronger than a direct Biq16 computation: it proves vanishing from the EXISTENCE of a KE desingularization, not from algebraic manipulation of curvature formulas. A01's planned Biq16 computation would serve as an independent algebraic cross-check.

combined_finding.statement: The product orbifold (S²×S²)/Z₂ passes ALL currently controlled Ozuch finite-dimensional obstructions for every chirality pattern r=0,1,2,3,4. Specifically:
combined_finding.first_obstruction: λ_k = 0 for all in-kernel ζ (rank-one R, 2D kernel)
combined_finding.scalar_projections: ν_l = 0 (A-symmetry eliminates scalar kernel modes, A01 Thm 2.1)
combined_finding.inter_node_interaction: O(t³) << O(t^{5/2}) at comparable scales, below Ozuch remainder
combined_finding.pattern_dependence: The first pattern-dependent effect is the mixed-chirality inter-node kernel block at order t³, which is currently invisible to Ozuch's finite-dimensional system.
combined_finding.consequence_for_construction: With all finite-dimensional obstructions cleared and the scalar kernel eliminated by A-symmetry (A01 Thm 2.1), the remaining problem is purely analytical: a weighted inverse estimate on the positive-definite non-scalar sector (gap ≥ Λ, A01 Cor 3.2) plus nonlinear contraction. If this succeeds, it would produce an exact positive Einstein metric on every mixed-chirality resolution of the product orbifold.
combined_finding.what_this_does_NOT_prove: This does not prove P₄⁺ or Yau-26. It establishes that the product quotient is an unobstructed candidate for Einstein desingularization in every chirality pattern. Whether the analytical estimates close is a separate PDE problem. And global Einstein existence (far from this orbifold degeneration) remains unaddressed.
